about.title: What is
about.summary: Union'S is the all-in-one platform connecting talents, startups and investors through AI-powered intelligent matching. We simplify connections to accelerate the startup ecosystem's growth.
about.missionDesc: Democratize access to the startup ecosystem by offering every talent, founder and investor the tools to find each other, collaborate and succeed together, regardless of their network or location.
about.visionDesc: Become the go-to reference for startup matching in Africa and internationally, creating a network where every connection creates value and every opportunity finds its champion.
about.whyDesc: The startup world is fragmented: talents seek impactful projects, founders lack qualified co-founders, and investors struggle to source the right opportunities. Union'S solves this by centralizing the ecosystem on an intelligent, transparent and accessible platform.

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Union'S.
faq.a1: Union'S is an AI-powered matching platform connecting talents, startups and investors. It centralizes the startup ecosystem to facilitate collaborations, co-founder recruitment and fundraising.
faq.a2: Yes, registration is 100% free. You can create your profile, explore the directory and receive matching recommendations. Premium features like direct contacts and boosted visibility are available through our paid plans.
faq.a3: Our algorithm analyzes your skills, industry, development stage and preferences to calculate a compatibility score with other profiles. The more complete your profile, the more accurate the recommendations.
faq.a4: Union'S is designed for 5 types of users: talents looking for startups, founders seeking co-founders or talent, investors sourcing deals, incubators managing cohorts, and partners (universities, corporates) wanting to connect with the ecosystem.
faq.a5: Absolutely. We use end-to-end encryption, strict security policies and host data on GDPR-compliant servers. Your contact information is never shared without your explicit consent.
faq.a6: Yes, our 360° Support offer provides tailored services: strategic coaching, fundraising assistance, legal advice and more. You can submit a request directly from the dedicated section without registration.
